title: Rabbi Huna HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8, speaking in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Ze’ira, and in Midrash Tehillim 106:2, speaking in the name of R’ Yirmeyah in the name of R’ Chiyya.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8 scalar fully writes Rabbi Huna HaKohen and Rabbi Shmuel bar Ze’ira. The whole OYW Midrash Tehillim 106:2 scalar fully writes Rabbi Huna HaKohen but abbreviates the personal titles of Yirmeyah and Chiyya; those two supplied abbreviations remain R’. The nested ‘in the name of’ chain is preserved, without adding the extra epithet or identifying other entries.
